_meta.assembly: Hand build. Only C1 and J1 are board placements; R1 is a BeO-flanged 250 W termination that bolts to the user's heatsink and only laps its RF tab onto the PCB, and the mounting hardware is customer-supplied.
_meta.note: CREATED AT U3 (2026-08-14) to make fab/BOM.csv REPRODUCIBLE. Until then this board's BOM of record was hand-authored and bom_cpl.py derived membership from the position export, so a regeneration silently dropped R1 and every assembly instruction with it (codex H1). The distributor, price and stock columns of the hand-authored fab/BOM.csv are preserved here in `assembly_notes`; the machine-checkable half (which parts exist, what class each one is, what the assembler must be told) is now canonical data. Prices are the 2026-08-08/09 DigiKey and LCSC quotes at qty 5 and are NOT re-verified by any check - re-quote at order time.

parts.assembly_notes: Air-dielectric trimmer 1-30 pF, 250 VDC, -65/+125 C, top-adjust. Tuning tool Johanson 8764 (0.130 in shank). Threaded case = GND, insulated lead = RF. Chosen over the cheaper Vishay BFC280811339 ONLY because that part is rated -40/+70 C and this board runs 74-88 C at full 150 W CW - see README section 6 for the reduced-duty alternative that saves 272 USD per build of 5. No LCSC line: DigiKey only.
SMA female right-angle THT jack, 50 ohm, 335 Vrms working, DC-6 GHz.

50 ohm +/-5% 250 W thick film on BeO flanged termination DC-4 GHz. SELECT-ON-TEST: 4-wire measure each part, accept 49.00-51.00 ohm, order spares. BeO substrate - do not machine, drill or break. Mounts OFF-BOARD to the user's heatsink; only its RF tab laps onto the PCB. Not a machine-placed part, so absent from CPL.csv by design.
parts.role: The 150 W CW load itself. Its land exists on the PCB; the part does not sit on it.

parts.assembly_notes: Prefer INSULATING shims (PEEK/nylon/fibre) - they are not needed electrically and they keep C1 cooler. 1.0 mm sets top copper at 2.635 mm against R1's tab underside at 2.667 mm.
Into the heatsink, 18.42 mm apart, through R1's own 3.302 mm flange holes.
Soldered R1 flange -> the two PCB GND lands. THIS IS THE ONLY RF RETURN PATH - do not rely on the bolted heatsink joint (418 pF / 15.2 ohm at 25 MHz on an anodised sink).
Thin even joint. On the 2.359 cm2 flange a 0.5 C.cm2/W joint costs 0.212 C/W - a third of the whole 0.633 C/W budget.
Must be <=0.421 C/W in free air for 150 W CW. Needs a >=7 mm dia, >=5 mm deep clearance hole under C1 (its case protrudes 4.75 mm below the PCB). See README section 3.
